name: pos-m3-resume-probe
title: POS campaign M3: interrupt/resume idempotence probe (resume-probe.mjs + run-batch resume mode, H3 evidence)
description: Fourth milestone of the proof-or-stop replay and tamper campaign (M0 DONE=B-9e44 protocol; M1 DONE=B-bae9 tamper arm; M2 DONE=B-2a5b replay driver + batch-ledger.jsonl). M3 delivers the RESUME arm for H3 (campaign integrity / proof-or-stop through interruptions): experiments/pos-instrument-replay/resume-probe.mjs (a committed producer) + a RESUME mode added to run-batch.mjs + resume-reconciliation.json + a selfcheck. resume-probe spawns the replay driver, kills it deterministically TWICE — (a) at a frozen iteration boundary (SIGKILL after K iterations recorded), (b) mid-iteration via the driver crash hook (POS_FAIL_APPEND_AT: after workspace write, before ledger append) — restarts the driver in RESUME mode (skip iterationIds already recorded), and reconciles: the ledger identity multiset must equal the protocol replay cross-product exactly (0 duplicates / 0 gaps); the mid-iteration casualty must resolve to a stop record or a clean re-run, never a silent half-record. resume-reconciliation.json records the pre/post-kill ledger diff, the identity-multiset comparison, dup/gap counts (must be 0/0), and the casualty disposition. run-batch.mjs gains an ADDITIVE resume mode (fresh-campaign path unchanged; M2 selfcheck + batch-ledger still valid). Reuses M0 lib/instrument.mjs + reads the frozen protocol.json.
